propositions: clarity_check returns verdict=fail with score >= threshold when Acceptance Criteria items are plain bullets instead of checkboxes, but reports no reason naming the structural-floor cause
the verdict is computed as a conjunction of score >= threshold AND floor.passes, but only the score half is returned in the output dict, leaving the failing structural-floor half invisible

ClarityResultOut and clarity_result.schema.json lack a reason field to carry the floor-defect evidence (empty ac_items, unchecked_ac_lines, sentinel_assignments), creating inconsistency with sibling gates check_ac and quality_check which do return reason
a pass must return the existing shape {score, verdict, threshold} without a reason field to avoid breaking existing consumers (AC3)

the reason field must name which condition failed (score floor or structural floor) and for structural floor which specific defect with line number (missing checklist, empty AC item, or unresolved sentinel)
